a: You can activate the part of the effect after "then" regardless of whether or not you could add a card with the [LIBERATOR] trait to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the 3 cards revealed for this card's [Main] effect don't include a card with the [LIBERATOR] trait, can I still play 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait and a play cost of 3 or less from my hand without paying the cost?

Effect: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [LIBERATOR] trait, you may ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, you may play 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait and a play cost of 3 or less from your hand without paying the cost.
